title: Fiveia NDE 7608
content: It was winter during school holidays. I was home alone. I ate breakfast and having gotten my little brother’s sled, I went off to sled on the ravine. It was a homemade sled, very heavy, made from metal in the shape of a little chair, with a strong back. The ravine was what we called the large quarry with little hills. Here we went sledding in the winter and the three ponds where we sunbathed and swam in the summer. There were already many children on the hill. Children would go down the hillside, jump on a trampoline, and then go further down the hill. I had been thinking how nice it would be to jump on the trampoline. But everything ended up differently. I jumped on the trampoline, but fell with my spine on the edge of the back of the sled. I wanted to cry out, but only wheezed. A horrible pain went through my whole body and I was seeing stars. My final thought was, 'I won’t survive this pain.' I started to black out, my thoughts became confused, and I thought that I was dying. Suddenly, I felt a large improvement. My thoughts became distinct and clear. I was pulled upward where I saw a bright white light. But the light did not blind me, it was calming and pleasant. I thought, 'What is that? What’s happening to me?' Then I saw myself in a meadow. I sat on the grass and was playing with the grass and flowers. The part of the meadow I was on was separated from another part by a small stream. On the other side was a girl, about 13 years old, sitting and holding a little book. There were four children sitting and listening to her. They briefly looked at me and then continued to do what they were doing. I somehow knew that I had to wait here until my fate: to stay here or to go back was decided. But I wanted to stay. Suddenly I heard someone calling, 'Miss, Miss!' I thought that someone was calling the girl, so I continued to sit there. Then the girl said to me, 'Don’t you hear, they’re calling you. Go back!’ I answered, 'I don’t want to go back. I like it here.' We again heard the call, and the girl said, 'Go back, they’re disrupting us.' 'Fine,' I said, 'I’ll go tell them to stop bothering us and then I’ll come back.' The girl only smiled at my words. I went to the edge of the stream and looked down. I saw myself lying in the snow with my arms thrown wide. At that instant I came to in my body.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Accident. Life threatening event, but not clinical death
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Unearthly light | Special knowledge or purpose
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Uncertain I lost awareness of my body
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal
elements.At what time during the experience were: My thoughts got mixed up from the strong pain and I started to black-out. The impact freed me from my body and suddenly my thoughts became distinct and clear as never before.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning
elements.Please compare your vision during the ex: I did not notice an improvement in vision, but colors seemed brighter there.
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: I did not notice that my hearing changed.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes I saw five unfamiliar children there.
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes When I came out of my body, I saw a bright white light. I was carried directly into it. Then I came to in a bright green field.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: It was so peaceful and pleasant there that I didn’t want to return for anything in the world.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: I remembered many past events I am sure that it was not a dream and that I was definitely in THAT world. After that event I looked for confirmation of this in print. Now there is more than enough confirmation. Fortunately, God gave me the ability to come out of my body and travel to that world, where I have now been seven times.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Have your religious practices changed si: Yes My convictions changed as an adult.
elements.Did your experience include features con: Content that was entirely not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes Previously I believed neither in God, nor in a purpose to life. Now everything is in its place. I believe that God exists. That the purpose of life is to do no evil to anyone, and then there will be peace on earth. We will not have to suffer on earth, and then bring punishment on ourselves in the next world for it.
elements.Concerning our Earthly lives other than: experience? God definitely exists Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion
elements.Do you believe in an afterlife after you: An afterlife definitely exists Yes Я была ещё семь раз на том свете и твёрдо уверена ,что жизнь после смерти есть!
elements.Were you fearful living your life after: Slightly fearful in living my earthly life
elements.What life changes occurred in your life: Large changes in my life Large changes in my life
elements.After the NDE: tionships changed specifically because of your experience? No After the NDE
elements.How accurately do you remember the exper: I do not know how my remembrance of the experience compares to my remembrance of other life events at time
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes I have premonitory dreams. For example, every year I dream about where I will spend my holidays. Also my soul can come out of my body and travel. I have made seven trips to that world and one on Earth in the body of an owl.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: It was very important for me to learn that the soul can separate from the body.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes I told someone, my husband, about it for the first time after ten years. He said that it was nonsense. Only recently has he started to believe some of it.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was probably real Because previously, no one had told me that such a thing was possible.
